record: Amendment A2 -- clarification C1 (Issue 2 baseline procedure)
type: post-hoc pre-training clarification of approved amendment A2

linked_to.why_separate_file: amendment_A2_approval.json certifies A2's exact bytes; editing A2 in place would break that approval record, so the clarification is a linked addendum and A2 remains byte-identical

provenance.data_inspected_for_this_clarification: distinct-value counts of the 26 admissible features within TRAIN (to check standardization feasibility); no scaling parameter, loss, or prediction was computed

user_decisions_recorded.baseline_selection: the non-learning baseline with the lowest VALIDATION primary prediction loss (frozen A2 criterion); NOT the recommendation/capture rate
eligible_baselines: mean by candidate x decision tick (tick = round(normalized_time x 180))
exact-input lookup, falling back to candidate x tick when the 26-feature input is unseen in TRAIN

one_nn.space: the 26 admissible state features only; the candidate descriptor is NOT part of the distance
one_nn.scaling: per-feature mean and standard deviation computed on TRAIN only, frozen, and applied to TRAIN, VALIDATION and PRIMARY TEST
one_nn.distance: ordinary Euclidean distance in the standardized 26-dimensional space
one_nn.prediction: candidate-conditioned: for candidate c at query state s, the TRAIN state(s) at the minimum distance are retrieved and their observed targets for candidate c are used; ties at the minimum distance are averaged

user_decisions_recorded.baseline_selector_tolerances: derived from the selected baseline's own VALIDATION prediction error, never from the learned model. A2 / selector_design.json specify target-specific formulas, preserved exactly: delta_U = 0.5 x the baseline's VALIDATION MAE on future_unmet; delta_H = 0.5 x the baseline's VALIDATION MAE on future_hazard_unmet; delta_T90 = delta_T100 = 0.5 tick (unchanged). The selected baseline's validation MAEs and the resulting tolerances are to be recorded before any PRIMARY TEST evaluation.

p2_p5_reference_frozen.assessable: YES (Delta >= 0.5, point-estimate rule as frozen in A2)
p2_p5_reference_frozen.note: the CI is descriptive and is not the assessability rule; the 0.5-tick P4 threshold is unchanged; the P2/P5 result is not used to tune anything

resolution_checklist.baseline_selection_rule_chosen: YES -- lowest VALIDATION primary prediction loss
resolution_checklist.one_nn_distance_specified: YES in principle -- but see OPEN-1 (zero-variance features)
resolution_checklist.train_only_scaling_enforced: YES by rule -- scaling parameters come from TRAIN only
resolution_checklist.baseline_tolerances_from_baseline_valida: YES -- target-specific, from the baseline's own VALIDATION error
resolution_checklist.no_primary_test_information_in_baseline_: YES -- selection and tolerances use TRAIN (fitting) and VALIDATION (selection, MAE) only
resolution_checklist.no_learned_model_information_in_baseline: YES -- the baseline selector's tolerances and quantiles depend only on the baseline

open_points_blocking_full_specification.OPEN-1_zero_variance_features: Three admissible features are constant within TRAIN: in_transit_R2_C1, in_transit_R3_C2, in_transit_R4_C2 (TRAIN standard deviation = 0). TRAIN-only standardization divides by zero for them. A rule is needed, e.g. (a) exclude zero-variance TRAIN features from the 1-NN distance, or (b) leave them unscaled (std := 1). The choice changes 1-NN distances on VALIDATION/TEST states where these features are non-zero.
open_points_blocking_full_specification.OPEN-2_selection_loss_aggregation: The primary prediction loss is defined per target (row-weighted mean pinball loss at q = 0.1/0.5/0.9 on future_T100 and on future_unmet). Selecting ONE baseline needs a single score: e.g. (a) the mean of the two per-target losses (unmet, on a larger scale, dominates), (b) the mean of the two losses each divided by the corresponding VALIDATION target standard deviation, or (c) lexicographic, T100 first. Not specified anywhere.
open_points_blocking_full_specification.OPEN-3_MAE_point_prediction: 'validation MAE' is unspecified as to which point prediction: the conditional mean (what the selector's objective uses) or the median quantile.
open_points_blocking_full_specification.OPEN-4_selector_OOD_distance: selector_design.json step 5 abstains when 'the nearest training input is farther than the 99th percentile of training nearest-neighbour distances' without defining the distance; it applies to both the learned and the baseline selector. Reusing the frozen 1-NN metric (standardized Euclidean over the 26 features, TRAIN scaling) is the obvious candidate but is not stated.
open_points_blocking_full_specification.OPEN-5_empirical_quantile_method: empirical TRAIN quantiles (baseline q_hi and quantile predictions) need an interpolation convention (numpy 'linear', as used in A1, or another).
